evals.expected_output: Parses MR !99, detects platform from context, verifies CLI authentication, then loops checking MR state, CI, unresolved discussions, rebase needs, and conflicts until merged, closed, stopped, or safety limit reached.

assertions.name: parses-mr
assertions.description: The response identifies MR !99 as the target.

assertions.name: monitor-loop
assertions.description: The response follows the monitoring loop for state, CI, discussions, and conflicts.

evals.prompt: Watch this merge request. CI is failing on lint.
evals.expected_output: Fetches CI failure details, classifies lint/style/type errors, makes a minimal fix, commits with ticket prefix inferred from recent history, pushes, and resumes monitoring.

assertions.name: ci-failure-handling
assertions.description: The response fetches and classifies CI failure details.

assertions.name: minimal-fix-and-push
assertions.description: The response fixes only the relevant issue, commits, pushes, and resumes watching.

evals.prompt: Keep an eye on MR !77, but it is already merged.
evals.expected_output: Detects the merged terminal state, prints a summary, and exits without continuing the watch loop.

assertions.name: terminal-merged-state
assertions.description: The response stops when the MR is already merged.

assertions.name: no-extra-loop
assertions.description: The response does not sleep or continue monitoring a terminal MR.
